title: Supply Chain Attack on W4SP Stealer family
technical_mechanism: injected into legit-looking libs; stole browser cookies/passwords/Discord tokens/crypto wallets
summary: A malicious package 'W4SP Stealer family' was discovered in the PyPI ecosystem. The attack involved typosquat cluster + credential stealer. Mechanism: injected into legit-looking libs; stole browser cookies/passwords/Discord tokens/crypto wallets
